verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API with Bearer-token auth, a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec, and an interactive try-it reference. Its successor developer portal covers SDKs and TypeScript SDK samples, and the MCP docs invite developers to build custom apps, agents, or bots. All of this supports external integrations rather than plugins that extend the app itself, and the current Beta API is slated for discontinuation on September 1, 2026. Missing for 10: an in-app plugin/extension API, plugin-specific samples or tutorials, a stable non-deprecated API generation evidenced directly, independent corroboration of SDK use.
